01 / 项目概述PROJECT OVERVIEW

把年货采购， 讲成一场跨山海的远征。AN EXPEDITION, FOR YOU.

为赵梦澈快手账号打造的辛选超级年货节商业短片，围绕年货采购与源头直采展开。A XinXuan Super New Year campaign film for Zhao Mengche on Kuaishou, centered on direct seasonal sourcing.

以海陆空跨越山海的物流行动，呈现全球供应链实力、产地品质与年货盛宴氛围。An expedition across land, sea and air brings supply-chain scale, origin quality and festive anticipation to life.

02 / 视觉构思VISUAL CONCEPT

自然伟力 × 工业统治NATURE / INDUSTRY

以极端环境、巨型载具和有序调度，建立供应链的规模感与可靠感。Extreme environments, monumental vehicles and precise coordination communicate scale and reliability.

全球军事级物流远征军A GLOBAL LOGISTICS EXPEDITION

01

超现实尺度MONUMENTAL SCALE

将酒樽、载具和捕捞渔网置入山海尺度，用巨物与自然的对比建立视觉记忆。Monumental bottles, vehicles and fishing nets turn the natural landscape into a spectacle of scale.

02

军事化调度PRECISE COORDINATION

舰队、车阵与直升机编队形成有序运动，让供应链的规模落在具体行动上。Ordered movement across fleets, convoys and airlifts makes the supply chain visible through action.

03

品牌贯穿A CONSISTENT IDENTITY

辛选红、载具标识与年货包装贯穿不同场景，使每一幕保持统一识别。XinXuan red, vehicle markings and seasonal packaging connect every scene into one visual identity.

03 / 统一视觉VISUAL SYSTEM

一套红色体系， 贯穿海陆空。ONE IDENTITY. LAND, SEA AND AIR.

轮船、捕捞船、货车与直升机构成海陆空载具体系。统一的辛选红、标识和包装，将不同任务连接成同一场远征。Ships, fishing vessels, trucks and helicopters share XinXuan red, markings and packaging, linking distinct operations into one expedition.

色彩系统COLOR SYSTEM

红色是跨镜头的品牌锚点。冷蓝与深绿铺陈自然环境，暖金光推动集结收束。Red anchors the brand across shots; cool blue and forest green shape the environments, while warm gold resolves the gathering.

主色依据报告定义，辅助色依据项目画面归纳。The primary color follows the report; supporting colors are drawn from the project imagery.

04 / 导演分镜STORYBOARD DIRECTION

从全球集结， 到万物归仓。FIVE ACTS. ONE COMPLETE JOURNEY.

按照52秒成片的镜头顺序，依次展开运输启动、坚果与酒水寻源、生鲜捕捞、全线集结和港口交付。以项目静态画面与局部重绘展示每一段的视觉与叙事。Following the 52-second film: transport launch, nut and wine sourcing, seafood harvest, full assembly and port delivery. Project stills and a redrawn wine scene illustrate the film’s chronological narrative.

  1. 01 / 00:00 - 00:16海陆空启动
  2. 02 / 00:16 - 00:26甄选坚果
  3. 03 / 00:26 - 00:34山河腹地
  4. 04 / 00:34 - 00:44南太平洋 · 极地生鲜
  5. 05 / 00:44 - 00:52全线集结
01

海陆空启动LAND / SEA / AIR MOBILIZATION

00:00 - 00:16

从舰队集结，到运输同时发动。MOBILIZATION INTO ACTION.

开场舰队驶向港口，驾驶舱操作切入直升机与货车编队。随着“辛选超级年货节正式启动”，安全带、启动按钮、火箭点火和车轮、螺旋桨的快切，将海陆空运输同时发动。The opening moves from the fleet and port to cockpit operations, helicopter formations and trucks. Seat belts, the start button, ignition, wheels and propellers launch the transport sequence.

GLOBAL
02

甄选坚果SELECTED NUTS

00:16 - 00:26

从森林产区，到坚果已就位。FROM THE FOREST TO READY.

云海与森林转入海拔1200米的产区，松鼠与坚果细节交代原料来源。随后礼盒货车驶出森林，以“甄选坚果，已就位”完成这一段集结。Misty forests introduce the 1,200-metre producing region. A squirrel and nut details establish the source; gift-box trucks move through the forest before the film announces that selected nuts are ready.

SOURCE
02 / LAND

成片由森林产区转入礼盒货车队，随后出现“甄选坚果，已就位”，完成坚果段落。The film moves from the forest origin to gift-box trucks and closes the sequence with the selected-nuts-ready announcement.

03

山河腹地WINE FROM THE HINTERLAND

00:26 - 00:34

以酒樽与吊装，接入纯粮甄酿。WINE SOURCING / AIRLIFT.

镜头沿公路进入山河腹地，巨型酒樽对应“纯粮甄酿”。直升机吊运酒水穿过森林与瀑布，以“品牌酒水，已就位”接入水流转场。The camera enters the hinterland along a road toward a monumental wine bottle. Helicopters carry wine through forests and waterfalls; the ready announcement leads into a water transition.

AIRLIFT
04

南太平洋 · 极地生鲜SOUTH PACIFIC / SEAFOOD

00:34 - 00:44

风暴、捕捞、丰收，进入全线集结。STORM / HARVEST / ASSEMBLY.

水流转入风暴与巨浪，货轮进入“南太平洋纯净海域”。随后巨网起吊、生鲜铺满船舱，“极地生鲜，已就位”完成寻源段落，再由“您的年货已全线集结”进入收束。Water gives way to storms and the South Pacific. The net rises and the deck fills with seafood; the film moves from the harvest-ready announcement to all New Year goods being assembled.

OCEAN
05

全线集结ALL ROUTES CONVERGE

00:44 - 00:52

海陆空汇合，集结完毕、邀您共赴。ASSEMBLED. FOR YOU.

公路车队、直升机吊装和港口货轮依次出现，成片发布“1月24日”年货节信息。集装箱落地后，港口转为地球汇聚与小狮子IP，以“集结完毕，邀您共赴”收尾。Road convoys, helicopter airlifts and port vessels appear in order, followed by the January 24 campaign date. Container delivery leads to a global gathering and the lion mascot in the closing invitation.

ARRIVAL

05 / 项目总结PROJECT SUMMARY

把寻源与交付， 连成一次年货集结。THE EXPEDITION, FOR YOU.

成片以海陆空运输启动开场，依次呈现坚果、酒水和生鲜“已就位”，再以“您的年货已全线集结”汇合三路运输。集装箱交付、地球汇聚与小狮子IP，将故事收束到“集结完毕，邀您共赴”。The film launches land, sea and air transport, then announces nuts, wine and seafood ready. The routes converge through port delivery, a global gathering and the lion mascot’s closing invitation.
